A truncated `map32` header causes an out-of-bounds buffer read and throws `RangeError` instead of `IncompleteBufferError`. Applications that rely on `IncompleteBufferError` to wait for additional bytes may terminate a request, stream, or worker unexpectedly. No adjacent memory is disclosed because the buffer implementation checks bounds.

### Patches

The decoder now validates the complete five-byte `map32` header before reading its length and reports truncated input as `IncompleteBufferError`.

### Workarounds

Require at least five bytes before decoding a value beginning with `0xdf`, or catch `RangeError` and treat it as incomplete input only for truncated `map32` headers.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-8f34-f56x-9xph", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-10-08T17:40:10Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8f34-f56x-9xph", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-8f34-f56x-9xph"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-107302"}], "nvd_published_at": null, "published_at": "2026-10-08T17:40:10Z", "references": ["https://github.com/mcollina/msgpack5/security/advisories/GHSA-8f34-f56x-9xph", "https://github.com/mcollina/msgpack5/commit/15443a1f2aa682a6aa37f1705ac628de5b866ad1", "https://github.com/mcollina/msgpack5/releases/tag/v6.1.0", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8f34-f56x-9xph"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/mcollina/msgpack5/security-advisories/GHSA-8f34-f56x-9xph", "severity": "high", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/mcollina/msgpack5", "summary": "msgpack5: Truncated map32 headers throw an unexpected error", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-10-08T17:40:11Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-8f34-f56x-9xph", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "6.1.0", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "msgpack5"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 6.1.0"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
